name: Mesh Roll Tape | Self-Adhesive Window Screen Repair Patch | 3M Anti-Insect Fiberglass
description:
Fix torn or damaged screens instantly with the Mesh Roll Tape – a quick, durable, and effective solution for keeping mosquitoes and insects out. Made from premium fiberglass mesh, this tape is tear-resistant, weatherproof, and long-lasting. Its strong adhesive backing ensures it stays firmly in place without peeling, even outdoors. Simply cut, peel, and stick – no tools required. With a 3-meter roll, you can repair multiple screens at home, during travel, or camping.
Key Features
 Strong self-adhesive – weather resistant
 Durable fiberglass mesh – tear & moisture proof
 Easy DIY repair – cut, peel & stick
 Multipurpose – windows, doors, tents, RVs, pools
 3-meter roll – multiple repairs in one
How to Use
 Clean the surface before applying
 Cut the tape to desired size
 Peel off the backing paper
 Stick firmly onto the damaged screen
Material
Fiberglass mesh + strong adhesive
Safety Information
 Apply only on dry, clean surfaces
 Keep out of children’s reach
 Avoid direct fire or extreme heat
Package Includes
 1 × Mesh Roll Tape (3M)
